name: Tiraxis excludes unsupported Mystic Enchanting specializations (#4740)
contract: Mystic Enchanting: Specialization 1806961 unlocks a specialization at an Enchanting Altar according to its item description. CoA has no Mystic Enchanting system: the item has neither an item script nor a use spell, and the existing Wildcard specialization cache contract also excludes it. The scenario inspects the vendor list sent by the native session after the actual gossip selection; it does not claim rendered client coverage.
